name: Kyodai
kurzbeschreibung:
**Kyodai in Füssen**

Discover the vibrant flavors of **Kyodai** in the charming town of **Füssen**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. This beloved Japanese restaurant invites you to experience authentic **ramen**, sushi, and other delicious dishes in a cozy, welcoming atmosphere.

Whether you're craving a hearty bowl of **shoyu ramen** or fresh **sashimi**, **Kyodai** offers a taste of Japan right in the Bavarian Alps. Pair your meal with a cold **Asahi** or a traditional Japanese tea for the perfect culinary escape.

Located near the picturesque **Hohenschwangau Castle**, **Kyodai** is the ideal spot to indulge in a unique dining experience after exploring the stunning landscapes of the **Alps**. Don’t miss out on this hidden gem in **Füssen**!
